narr: The region was under the influence of high pressure on August 19th, 2021, with a warm, humid airmass in place over northeast OH. PWAT values ranged from 1.5 to 1.7 with MLCAPE values from 500 to 1000 j/kg. Thunderstorms with intense rainfall rates developed over Trumbull County during the afternoon hours, with rates peaking near 2.5 per hour. The Niles and Vienna Township areas received multiple rounds of thunderstorms, with storm total rainfall amounts of 1.00 to 2.50.
ev: Video of several inches to foot deep water rapidly flowing through backyards up against homes in the Bentwillow Drive neighborhood in Niles. Reports of several basements flooded in this area. A pond overflowed onto Niles Vienna Road in Vienna Township, where a car hydroplaned through the flowing water and ended up submerged in the pond. KYNG ASOS nearby reported 2.36 of rainfall in a 40 minutes period.
